The '''''Gi'ka''''', or "little [[Fish/Legends|fish]]" in [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]], was a [[Wavechaser]] purchased by [[Kal Skirata]] and given to [[Mereel Skirata]] during the hunt for [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]]. It was purchased by Kal Skirata for Mereel on [[Dorumaa]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. After Kal and the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Nulls]] found Ko Sai, it was stored in ''[[Aay'han]]''{{'s}} cargo hold.
